claims: Passive and merely posted liquidity are not rewardable without external-flow service.
A positive liquidity reward requires external fee or safety-lift surplus after subtracting self-flow, inventory recycling, overlap, and safety margin.
If recapturable terms dominate external fee plus safety lift, any non-negative liquidity reward collapses to zero.
Defended and oracle-safe liquidity classes refine the external-flow service class.
Winner-only bonus credits are clipped by expected winners, per-winner cap, and available epoch budget.
Realized bonus value cannot exceed paid bonus credits when expected-value basis points are at most 10000.
Bonus credits collapse to zero when honest demand exhausts the epoch budget or when no expected winners exist.

boundaries: These are local reward-admission arithmetic gates, not a complete tokenomics equilibrium theorem.
Deployments still need runtime evidence that externalFee, safetyLift, selfFlow, inventoryRecycle, overlap, and safetyMargin are measured correctly.
Bonus-bet issuance is modeled as bounded credits; this receipt does not claim securities, gambling, tax, or regulatory safety.
The proofs constrain payout admission; they do not select a policy for reward rates, eligibility, or expected-value basis points.
